about: Sotavento's PWA Slalom X course, laid from the event's zone map of 2026 (fuerteventura-worldcup.org): the start up the coast and about 500 m out, four gybe marks zigzagging downwind (broad reaches of about 125 degrees in the NNE trade wind), the finish outside the freestyle box opposite the judges' tower. The map is a drawing, not a survey: the positions are the lead's reading of it (Documentation/reports/spots/sotavento/PLAN.md, section 6). Positions are REGCAN95 / UTM 28N metres; sides are the side each mark is left on.
name: PWA Slalom X, Sotavento
